overall_reason: A 'Project tasks' card with '3 open' and three rows of task, owner, due day and status: a quiet list that serves the task.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass for a small Operate card; T-BOLD-MOVE fails because statuses share one grey style, and T-RIVAL-NAME holds for any task tool.

findings.title: Spend boldness in one place
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png 'Ready', 'In review' and 'Ready' are set in the same small grey text as the owner and due lines.
findings.after: Mark the status that needs action, for example 'In review', with weight or a colour dot.
findings.why: The reader has to read every row to find the one that needs them.

strengths: Each row pairs task, owner and due day ('Design review / Maya · Today'), and the header count '3 open' sums the list.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
